title: 第十七章 你在教我做事第十八章 轻功也有火候了
content_zh:
虽然昨晚什么都没发生，但第二天醒来，王昱似乎依然能够感觉到鼻尖的发丝轻挠和百合幽香，以及那一双似乎会说话的眼睛。
“太会撩了！”
若不是自己上一世通过各种渠道上见多识广，只怕此时不是被吊成翘嘴，就是已经变成舔狗。
王昱感慨一声，就听到门口丫鬟轻轻敲门，“王爷，赵管事来了。”
“进来吧。”王昱回了一声，起身下床。
……
“三位将军和赵都尉已经到了，咱们先举办给老王爷的祭奠礼会，然后再接见他们。”赵英杰一边给王昱讲解流程，一边说道。
此时王昱已经换了一身王侯礼服，庄严肃穆，由赵英杰陪同，来到了王府正殿。
赵峥去世三月，早已下葬，但王昱一直没有回来，所以正式的祭奠礼会一直没有举办，如今等到王昱回来，礼会才终于举行。
这场礼会，代表着镇西王府主人变更，从赵峥时代，进入到赵……王昱时代。
旗幡飘扬，鼓乐叮咚，香烟袅袅，文祭幽冥。
一场祭奠持续了大半天，但其实一切都是赵嵘在主持，王昱要做的事情并不多，但他却是占据核心，因为这场祭奠礼会，也是他接掌镇西王府的仪式。
李云岫和芊芊也是素色盛装出席，一左一右，代表着镇西王府新任的两位女主人。
……
“参见王爷！”
“诸位将军请起！”
王昱在观察着眼前四人，眼前四人也在观察着王昱。
一个须发俱白，眼中掩藏不住高傲神态的老者，这是当年跟随赵凌一起创建镇西王府的老将，赵思齐。
一个身高接近两米，腰围顶王昱两个半的壮汉，这是从战场杀出来的杀神，彭虎。
一个平常身材，面色从容，眼神深邃，仿佛永远在观察别人的中年人，这是镇西王府最有名的智将，陆云舟。

还有一个身材壮实的汉子，皮肤黝黑，沉默寡言，这是统领三千铁鹰骑的都尉，赵德方。
其中赵思齐和赵德方都是赵家本家，也算赵昱的族中远亲。
“王爷困居京城十年，实在是受苦了。”陆云舟率先开口。
“老皇帝没有自知之明，他还真以为有自己有开国太祖的本事，征北不利，平南又不利，搞得天下不稳，说不得咱们还有去金銮殿坐坐的机会。”彭虎咧嘴说道。
“住口，这话是你能说的吗？”赵思齐呵斥一声，然后看向王昱，“如今天下不稳，皇帝派来个女状元，摆明了是想拿镇西王府当填旋。
在我看来，咱们应当立杀此女，断了皇帝的念想，也安了天下担心，如此两全其美，可坐收渔人之利，如此退可固守西北，进可逐鹿中原，方为正道！”
会客堂霎时安静下来。
三位将军和赵德方都不说话，唯一相陪的赵嵘也没说话，他是镇西王府的大管家，但涉及军政大事，他却不方便插话。
王昱环视一眼，看着众人表现，虽然不知道这是不是他们商量好的，但赵思齐试图给他一个下马威，却是确定无疑的。
“咚！咚！咚！”
王昱坐在桌前，面无表情的敲着桌子，淡淡的看着赵思齐，“你在教我做事？”
“不敢！”赵思齐正色抱拳，“我这是为了镇西王府着想，不想镇西王府去做皇帝手中之刀！”
王昱眼神微眯，竖起一根手指。
“第一，李云岫如今是我尚未完婚的王妃，天下尽知，我杀她便是杀妻，我名声有损便是镇西王府名声有损。”
“第二，如今只是天下不稳，不是天下大乱，我杀李云岫，就是与皇帝翻脸，如果皇帝准备拿镇西王府立威，在镇西王府名声有损、尽失民心的情况下，你怎么固守西北？”
“第三，李云岫殿试三甲得中状元，舌战群臣治国无双，可出将入相，杀了她只会断绝天下人才的归附之心，乃是断绝王府根基之举，你怎么逐鹿中原？”
“第四，留下李云岫，与朝廷虚与委蛇，就可稳皇帝之心，令李云岫尽展其才，还能增西北之力，这才叫两全其美。”
“第五。”王昱整个右手都张开了，“留下李云岫，朝廷之令如果对我们有利，我们就可以奉令而行，如果对我们不利，我们就可以置之不理，这才叫进退皆可。”
“还要我说第六、第七和第八吗？”王昱盯着赵思齐。
赵思齐面色涨红，胡须颤抖，一时说不出话来。

“赵老将军当年与家祖并肩作战，于西北酣战数十年，确实劳苦功高，但这次的提议却大失水准，令人诧异。”
王昱嘴角带笑，但声音却冷如寒冰，“我只能猜测赵老将军是年纪大了脑子跟不上了，总不会是您故意害我，想要覆灭镇西王府吧？”
content_en:
Although nothing happened last night, when Wang Yu woke up the next day, he still seemed to be able to feel the gentle tickle of hair on the tip of his nose, the fragrance of lilies, and a pair of eyes that seemed to be able to speak.
"So good at flirting!"
If I hadn't been well-informed through various channels in my previous life, I'm afraid that I would either be hung up or turned into a licking dog.
Wang Yu sighed and heard the maid knocking gently on the door, "Your Majesty, Manager Zhao is here."
"Come in." Wang Yu replied, got up and got out of bed.
…
"The three generals and Captain Zhao have arrived. Let's hold a memorial ceremony for the old prince first, and then receive them." Zhao Yingjie said while explaining the process to Wang Yu.
At this time, Wang Yu had changed into a royal attire, solemnly and solemnly, and was accompanied by Zhao Yingjie to the main hall of the palace.
Zhao Zheng passed away in three months and was buried long ago, but Wang Yu never came back, so the formal memorial ceremony was never held. Now, after Wang Yu came back, the ceremony was finally held.
This ceremony represents the change of the owner of the Zhenxi Palace, from the Zhao Zheng era to the Zhao...Wang Yu era.
Flags and flags are fluttering, drums are tinkling, cigarettes are curling, and cultural offerings are offered to the underworld.
The memorial ceremony lasted for most of the day, but Zhao Rong was actually the one presiding over everything. Wang Yu didn't have much to do, but he occupied the core, because this memorial ceremony was also the ceremony for him to take over the Zhenxi Palace.
Li Yunxiu and Qianqian also attended in plain clothes, one on the left and one on the right, representing the two new hostesses of Zhenxi Palace.
…
"See you, my lord!"
"Generals, please rise!"
Wang Yu was observing the four people in front of him, and the four people in front of him were also observing Wang Yu.
An old man with white beard and hair and a arrogant look in his eyes is Zhao Siqi, the veteran who founded Zhenxi Palace with Zhao Ling.
A strong man with a height of nearly two meters and a waist that is two and a half times the size of Wang Yu. This is the god of death, Peng Hu, who emerged from the battlefield.
A middle-aged man with an average build, a calm face, and deep eyes, as if he is always observing others. This is the most famous wise general of Zhenxi Palace, Lu Yunzhou.
There was also a sturdy man with dark skin and a taciturn nature. This was the captain in charge of three thousand Iron Eagle Cavalry, Zhao Defang.
Among them, Zhao Siqi and Zhao Defang are both members of the Zhao family, and can also be regarded as distant relatives of Zhao Yu.
"My prince has been trapped in the capital for ten years and has really suffered." Lu Yunzhou was the first to speak.
"The old emperor has no self-awareness. He really thinks that he has the ability of the founder of the country. It is unfavorable to conquer the north and unfavorable to pacify the south, making the world unstable. There is no chance that we will have a chance to sit in the Jinluan Palace." Peng Hu said with a grin.
"Shut up, are you allowed to say this?" Zhao Siqi scolded, and then looked at Wang Yu, "Now that the world is unstable, the emperor sent a female champion, who made it clear that he wanted to use Zhenxi Prince's Mansion as a fill-in.
In my opinion, we should kill this woman immediately to stop the emperor's thoughts and calm the world's worries. This way, we can get the best of both worlds and reap the benefits of the fishermen. If we retreat, we can stick to the northwest, and if we advance, we can compete in the Central Plains. This is the right way! "
The living room suddenly became quiet.
Neither the three generals nor Zhao Defang spoke, nor did the only one accompanying them, Zhao Rong. He was the chief steward of Zhenxi Palace, but it was inconvenient for him to interrupt when it came to important military and political matters.
Wang Yu glanced around and looked at everyone's performance. Although he didn't know if this was what they had discussed, it was certain that Zhao Siqi was trying to give him a blow.
"Boom! Boom! Boom!"
Wang Yu sat at the table, knocked on the table expressionlessly, and looked at Zhao Siqi calmly, "Are you teaching me how to do things?"
"Don't dare!" Zhao Siqi clasped his fists sternly, "I am doing this for the sake of Zhenxi Prince's Palace. I don't want Zhenxi Palace to become the sword in the emperor's hand!"
Wang Yu narrowed his eyes slightly and raised a finger.
"First, Li Yunxiu is now my unmarried princess, and everyone in the world knows that if I kill her, I will kill my wife, and my reputation will be damaged.The reputation of Zhenxi Palace has been tarnished. "
"Secondly, the world is now unstable, not in chaos. If I kill Li Yunxiu, I will fall out with the emperor. If the emperor is going to use the Zhenxi Palace to establish his power, how can you stick to the northwest when the reputation of the Zhenxi Palace is tarnished and the people's support is lost? "
"Thirdly, Li Yunxiu won the first prize in the top three examinations in the palace. She was unparalleled in running the country through verbal battles with the ministers. She could be a general or a prime minister. Killing her would only cut off the attachment of talents in the world and cut off the foundation of the palace. How can you compete in the Central Plains? "
"Fourth, by leaving Li Yunxiu behind and fighting with the imperial court, we can stabilize the emperor's heart, allow Li Yunxiu to fully display his talents, and also increase the power of the northwest. This is called the best of both worlds. "
"Fifth. Wang Yu opened his whole right hand and said, "Leave Li Yunxiu. If the court's order is beneficial to us, we can obey it. If it is not good for us, we can ignore it. This is called advancing or retreating." "
“Do you want me to say sixth, seventh and eighth? "Wang Yu stared at Zhao Siqi.
Zhao Siqi's face turned red, his beard trembled, and he was speechless for a moment.
"Old General Zhao fought side by side with his family ancestors and fought fiercely in the northwest for decades. He indeed worked hard and made great achievements, but his proposal this time is of a very low standard, which is surprising. "
Wang Yu had a smile on his lips, but his voice was as cold as ice, "I can only guess that General Zhao is too old and his brain can't keep up. It's not like you deliberately harmed me and wanted to destroy the Zhenxi Palace, right? "
